cli.intro: open-panel — local ops panel for services, sites, processes, and logs. One installable with `client` (desktop GUI), `server` (WebUI), and `servers` (multi-server roster).

cmd.capabilities: Report domain capabilities and their availability
cmd.audit: Read audit records for the current actor
cmd.client: Open the desktop client GUI and pump host events until it closes
cmd.server: Start the local WebUI listener for browser access
cmd.servers: Manage the local multi-server roster used by the client
cmd.servers-list: List managed servers and the active selection
cmd.servers-add: Add or update a managed server entry

opt.actor: Audit actor id (user or agent name)
opt.actor-source: Audit actor source (cli, skill, client, server, ...)
opt.content-dir: Directory containing the staged panel UI build
opt.title: Desktop window title
opt.kind: Filter audit records by actor kind
opt.id: Filter audit records by actor id
opt.capability: Filter audit records by capability id
opt.server-label: Human label for the managed server
